messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming_tail_latency.p99 exceeded threshold (threshold=8000ms) in region-us-west-2 for 3m. Service: realtime-chat-stream. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/streaming/realtime-latency :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert routed to eng-runtime (primary: oncall-ryan, secondary: oncall-maya). Escalation timer started. :bell:

oncall-ryan: Acknowledged. Looking at traces + node health. p95 ~ 300ms, p99 up to 11s on streaming endpoints. Batch (non-stream) gen not impacted.

telemetry-bot: NOTE: sudden spike in corrected ECC count on host gpu-rack21-node9 between 15:11:02 and 15:13:00 UTC. Delta corrected ECC = 73.

infra-sre: Pulling node telemetry now. `nvidia-smi` snapshot and dmesg show repeated MIG resets and thermal warnings. Node: gpu-rack21-node9 (AZ: usw2a). Sample:```
Timestamp: 2026-03-15T15:12:40Z
GPU: NVIDIA H100
ECC corrected errors: 73 (since last hour)
Thermal alert: THERMAL_THROTTLE_ACTIVE
Driver dmesg: [gpu_rq timeout] kernel_wait exceeded 12000ms
Processes: /opt/redwood/runtime/stream-worker (pid 42211)
```

eng-runtime: Traces show many streaming workers blocking on CUDA kernel completion. Streaming layer queues rebuild after kernel resumes, causing token-delay spikes. Also seeing KV cache reloads concurrently but not primary cause.

oncall-maya: @oncall-ryan want me to take customer comms and status updates?

oncall-ryan: Yes please take pager. I'll coordinate mitigation. Quick plan: 1) Enable immediate route override to `chat-stream-quantized-v2` for heavy sessions 2) Evict pods from gpu-rack21-node9 and cordon node 3) If eviction stalls, scale up a warm spare and rebind pods 4) Open hardware ticket if node confirms hw fault.

incident-bot: ACTION: expanded incident ticket INC-20260315-02 created (severity=2). Runbook link: /runbooks/gpu-throttle.

infra-sre: Cordon + drain started: `kubectl cordon gpu-rack21-node9 && kubectl drain gpu-rack21-node9 --grace-period=30 --timeout=6m --ignore-daemonsets`

eng-runtime: Applying route override: `routes.set_override("realtime-heavy", "chat-stream-quantized-v2", canary=0.15)` -> metrics look better on canary: p99 reduced from 11s -> 4.2s for that slice.

support-jen: Getting inbound support noise: clients reporting "tokens stop streaming and resume later" and some webhooks showed partial payloads. Tickets: 9 in last 12m. Major customer: gamma-ml (prod).

infra-sre: Drain progress: 60% pods evacuated. One pod failed to re-schedule due to GPU topology mismatch (node selector requires 80GB HBM). Triggering infra to provision matching instance.

eng-runtime: Canary at 15% -> 50% since metrics stable for 2m. P99 for full streaming service trending toward baseline at ~1.6s for override route.

oncall-ryan: Continue route ramp to 100% if no regressions. If autoscale is slow, consider temporarily reducing per-worker token budget to lower memory footprint.

oncall-maya: Posting status: "Investigating increased streaming tail latency in us-west-2. Some customers may see delayed token streams. Mitigation in progress." Email update sent to gamma-ml and partners.

infra-sre: New spare node provisioned (h100-equivalent), attaching to cluster. Rescheduling remaining pods. Node gpu-rack21-node9 now drained. Marking node out-of-service and raising vendor RMA: HW-7332.

eng-runtime: After full switch to quantized route and drained node, p95 = 340ms, p99 = 1.7s across realtime-chat-stream. Streaming stalls appear resolved. Observability shows ECC corrected error rate dropping after node removal.

support-jen: gamma-ml confirms streams returned. "We hit a user-facing stall for ~3 minutes, but resumed; please keep us posted on root cause."

pm-oliver: Initial impact summary for incident record: - Window: 15:10 - 15:25 UTC - Service: realtime-chat-stream (us-west-2) - Peak p99: ~11s - Sessions impacted estimate: ~180 sessions (~0.4% regional traffic) - Severity: Sev2 - Root cause (suspected): GPU ECC spike + thermal throttling on gpu-rack21-node9 causing kernel stalls.

eng-runtime: Action items proposed: 1) HW RMA + rack cooling inspection (owner: infra-sre) 2) Add telemetry alert: corrected ECC delta > 50 in 5m -> preemptive drain (owner: telemetry) 3) Tune autoscaler warm pool with H100-equivalent pre-warmed nodes (owner: eng-platform + infra-sre) 4) Streaming worker improvement: lower in-flight kernel timeout and better backpressure handling (owner: eng-runtime).

infra-sre: Logged vendor case, scheduled onsite engineer for cooling/physical checks. Also enabling a short-term remediation: monitor ECC corrected delta and auto-cordon node if threshold exceeded (testing config now).

oncall-ryan: Handing pager to oncall-maya. I'll stay on the thread and help with postmortem. :white_check_mark:

oncall-maya: Taking pager. I'll assemble timeline and coordinate post-incident comms. Postmortem due in 48h.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation successful, p99 returned to baseline. Incident remains open for follow-ups.

support-jen: I'll compile support ticket list and flag contracts with p99 SLOs for review on credits.

pm-oliver: Assigning owners: HW RMA & rack checks -> infra-sre; ECC alert rule & auto-cordon -> telemetry-bot + eng-platform; Streaming worker timeout/backpressure -> eng-runtime. Postmortem owner: oncall-ryan.

oncall-maya: Closing hands-on mitigation. Will re-open pager if anything regresses. Thanks team. :pray:
